overview:
Sparkonomy's homepage is a single, dark, **scroll-driven story** ("Sparking Creator livelihoods") that introduces the company through the founders' YouTube/Google background and ends in its first product, **Open Creator Graph** — a free "Creator Record" that lets Creators be visible to AI and control how AI uses their identity. Every conversion point goes to the external app https://creatorgraph.sparkonomy.com.

### Structure
- A fixed, transparent **header** (wordmark, 4 links, gradient pill CTA; hamburger + full-screen menu below 768px) over a fixed full-viewport **WebGL fluid-ink canvas** and a radial vignette that stay behind everything.
- **Hero** (not pinned): animated gradient "Sparkonomy" wordmark, tagline, a "NEW" launch card for Open Creator Graph with the CTA, a partner-logo marquee (Meta, YouTube, Google for Startups, Gemini) and a "READ OUR STORY" cue.
- **Six pinned story screens** (`position: sticky` panels inside 200–420svh tall sections) whose lines reveal "beat by beat" as you scroll, with word-by-word colour "ink" effects.
- **Creator Record** demo (normal flow): example record card for "Chulbuli Dixit" with per-facet AI-usage stances, plus the second CTA.
- **Closing** pinned screen ("And we're only getting started." / "Let's spark together.") and a black **footer**.

### Character
Black canvas, white Roboto type at large sizes (64px headlines at 1440px), a two-colour brand gradient (magenta `#DE0075` → violet `#8134AF`) used for CTAs and word highlights, and constant ambient motion (fluid simulation, wordmark pulse, CTA gradient sweep). The page also **auto-plays**: after 10 seconds without input it starts scrolling itself through the story.

### Facts
- Document height at 1440×900: 17,082px (fully rendered; the first automated capture measured 17,374px before the lazy card settled). 390×844: 15,984px. 834×1112: 20,766px.
- Headings: 1 H1 ("Sparkonomy"), 9 H2s, 1 H3. Links: 8 internal destinations (/, /creator/earn, /about, /contact, /blogs, /legal/privacy-policy, /legal/terms, /legal/refund-policy), 1 external app (https://creatorgraph.sparkonomy.com) linked 5 times, 5 social profiles (footer only).
- Built with Next.js 16.0.7 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion; hosted behind Google Frontend; GTM + GA4 + Microsoft Clarity + CookieYes.

(32px/40px bold; `min(20px, 5.2vw)` mobile), CTA "Claim your free Creator Record" (263×51), caption "Open Creator Graph" (16px/500) + "BY SPARKONOMY" (12px uppercase, letter-spacing .12em, white/50).

### Intro sequence (from the page bundle, verified with timed screenshots)
| Time after hero mount | What happens |
|---|---|
| 0 ms | Only the wordmark is visible, vertically centred (launch row collapsed: `grid-template-rows: 0fr`, spacer `flex-grow: 1`). Wordmark pulse/float loops start. |
| 200–900 ms | Tagline enters (`tailwindcss-animate` fade-in + slide-in-from-bottom 0.75rem, 700ms, delay 200ms). |
| ~300–1500 ms | Fluid canvas mounts on `requestIdleCallback` (timeout 1,500ms; 300ms fallback). |
| 3,000 ms (or first wheel / touchmove / keydown) | "Ready": row expands (`grid-template-rows` 1,000ms ease-in-out), spacer collapses (`flex-grow` 1,000ms), fluid gets a 10-splat burst. |
| +1,000 ms | Launch card: opacity 0→1, translateY 8px→0, 900ms ease-out. |
| +1,050 ms | Row `overflow: hidden` removed (card glow can bleed). |
| +1,700 ms | Partner row reveals (900ms) and the marquee starts moving. |
| +2,200 ms | READ OUR STORY reveals (900ms). |

In the captured run (proxied network) the tagline became visible at ~3.5s and the card at ~4.0s after navigation (see "Page-load sequence").

typography.notes:
### Font families
- **Roboto** (variable, weights 100–900) — the only face used on the homepage. Self-hosted through `next/font`: `/_next/static/media/roboto_latin_wght-s.p.4075f395.woff2` (67,264 bytes, WOFF2, `font-display: swap`, preloaded). CSS family name `roboto`, applied on `<body>` via class `roboto_51c32070-module__YpxGXa__className`.
- Fallback metric-matched face **"roboto Fallback"** = `local(Arial)` with `ascent-override: 92.43%; descent-override: 24.32%; line-gap-override: 0%; size-adjust: 100.37%` (prevents layout shift).
- Also declared but **not used on the homepage**: `robotoTool`, `robotoBlog` (same Roboto file, aliases for other pages) and **Solitreo** 400 (`solitreo_latin_400-s.p.8dc56742.woff2`, 25,944 bytes) — preloaded on the homepage but never rendered (`document.fonts` status "unloaded").
- Weights in use: 400, 500, 600, 700. No italics. Text is `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased` (Tailwind `antialiased` on the root wrapper).

### Behaviour
- Fluid sizes with `clamp()` above 768px (story headline `clamp(2.75rem, 4.45vw, 4rem)`, body `clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.8rem)`, sub-headline `clamp(2rem, 3.05vw, 2.75rem)`); fixed sizes below 768px.
- Orphan control: JS "glue" spans (`data-glue`) keep the last two words of each line together (`white-space: nowrap`) and are re-balanced by a ResizeObserver.
- Uppercase is applied only with CSS `text-transform` (source copy is sentence case).

animationsNotes:
Motion is central to this page. Sources: the page's own JS chunks (`414c2cf9ce43ae7e.js` story components, `c75f5b915cd1ec52.js` fluid wrapper, `4884221f851638c7.js` fluid engine, `517217656e425c14.js` content constants) and CSS (`0c8365a30c76d7c2.css`). All timings below are copied from that code; screenshots in `screenshots/_motion/` show them in action. Everything honours `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (static gradient background instead of WebGL, screens become normal-flow sections, no beats/ink/marquee/sweep).

### Scroll architecture
- Each story screen is a `<section data-tour-beats="N">` with `height: (100 + 55·N + 45)svh` — 2 beats → 255svh, 5 → 420svh, 1 → 200svh, 3 → 310svh — containing a `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh` stage. Consecutive screens overlap by `margin-top: -100svh`.
- Scroll progress p ∈ [0,1] = (scrollY − sectionTop) / (sectionHeight − 100svh), tracked with Framer Motion `useScroll` / `useTransform`.
- Beat windows: n = (0.84 − 45/(55N + 45))/N; beat i enters over [0.06 + i·n, 0.06 + i·n + min(0.32n, 0.14)] with smoothstep easing: `opacity 0→1`, `translateY 16px→0`. The whole stage fades out over p 0.9→1.0.
- Measured beat stops at 1440×900 (scrollY where each beat is fully in): roots 1,148 / 1,532; people 2,683 / 3,086 / 3,489 / 3,892 / 4,294; reality 5,563 / 5,966 / 6,369 / 6,772 / 7,174; love 8,303 / 8,687; turn 9,698 / 10,082; mission 11,038; future 14,194 / 14,588 / 14,983.

animations.Name: WebGL fluid "ink" background
animations.Trigger: Mounted on requestIdleCallback (timeout 1,500ms; 300ms fallback); runs continuously via requestAnimationFrame
animations.Timing: Navier–Stokes-style simulation with the library defaults ("baseline" mode on the homepage): simResolution 128, dyeResolution 1024, densityDissipation 1, velocityDissipation 0.2, pressure 0.8 (20 iterations), curl 30, splatRadius 0.25, splatForce 6000, shading on, colorful on (colorUpdateSpeed 10, random hues), brightness 0.5, bloom on (8 iterations, resolution 256, intensity 0.8, threshold 0.6, soft knee 0.7), sunrays on (resolution 196, weight 1), background #000000. Canvas resolution capped at devicePixelRatio 1.
animations.Interaction: 10-splat burst when the hero intro completes; pointer movement over the page paints ink (hover mode); scrolling "stirs" the fluid — every ≥50ms the accumulated scroll delta injects a vertical splat at the pointer position (force clamped ±6% of splatForce, colour strength min(1, |Δ|/40)). Touch handlers are passive.
animations.Notes: Engine API (start, stop, togglePause, multipleSplats, splatAtLocation, setConfig, downloadScreenshot) matches the open-source `webgl-fluid-enhanced` package (identification inferred; the package name is not in the bundle). A "tuned" mode exists in code (calmer ink, auto edge splats every 2,300ms, per-beat splats in brand colours) but the homepage passes `fluid: "baseline"`.

### Breakpoints
Tailwind defaults (640 / 768 / 1024 / 1280 / 1536px). The homepage effectively switches at **768px (`md`)** only; story type above 768px is fluid via `clamp()`.

| | Desktop 1440×900 | Tablet 834×1112 | Mobile 390×844 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Header | Logo 26px + 4 links + pill CTA | same as desktop (≥768px) | Logo 24px + hamburger; full-screen menu |
| Wordmark | 96px | 96px | 50.7px (13vw) |
| Story H2 | 64px (4.45vw capped at 4rem) | 44px (clamp minimum) | 44px |
| Story body | 28.8px | 20px | 20px |
| Hero card | 560px wide, padding 40/40/28 | 560px | 368px max, padding 36/16/32 |
| Partner marquee | 560px, gap 48px | 560px | full bleed, gap 40px |
| Creator Record | 2-col grid (340px card + text), sticky | 2-col grid | stacked; card collapsed until heading passes |
| Footer | 4-column grid | 4-column grid | wordmark + 2-col links + badges |
| Page height | 17,082px | 20,766px | 15,984px |

### Mobile specifics
- Hamburger menu with partner + compliance badges (not shown in the desktop header).
- Line breaks are art-directed per breakpoint (`<br class="md:hidden">` / `hidden md:block`), e.g. "For years, / we built / the platform." and "But what stayed with us were / the Creators / who brought it to life."
- Height units use `svh`/`lvh` so mobile browser chrome does not cause jumps; the fluid canvas is 100lvh.
- Touch: fluid touch handlers are passive; touchstart cancels the auto-tour.
- Cookie banner spans the full width (366×127px) and covers the top of the hero until dismissed.

### Not verified
- Landscape phones, very wide screens (>1536px) and 1024–1280px laptop widths were not captured: **Unable to determine** exact rendering there beyond what the CSS implies.
technical:
### Framework & build
- **Next.js 16.0.7** (`window.next = {version: "16.0.7", appDir: true}`), App Router with React Server Components (`self.__next_f` flight payload), **Turbopack** production chunks (`turbopack-e1c03c7346098e89.js`). The page body bails out to client-side rendering (`<template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING">`), but the story markup is server-rendered.
- **React 19** — the client bundle carries `19.3.0-canary-52684925-20251110` (Next's vendored React); the module path references `react@19.2.5` / `react-dom@19.2.5`.
- **Tailwind CSS** (v3.x inferred from the `--tw-*` preflight variables and `size-*` utilities; no version banner) + **tailwindcss-animate** (`animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-3`), shadcn/ui-style HSL tokens in `:root` (`--primary: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%`, `--primary-foreground: 210 40% 98%`).
- **Framer Motion** (`motion.*` components, `useScroll`, `useTransform`, `useMotionValueEvent`) for scroll-linked beats; version **Unable to determine**.
- WebGL2 fluid simulation (see Animations), loaded as a separate lazy chunk (`4884221f851638c7.js`, 55KB).
- Polyfills: core-js 3.38.1. react-hot-toast (goober) is present in a shared chunk but not used on the homepage.
- `/runtime-env.js` sets `window.__ENV__ = {"API_BASE":"https://app-api.sparkonomy.com"}`.

### Hosting, delivery, headers
- `server: Google Frontend`, `via: 1.1 google` → served from Google Cloud (exact product, e.g. Cloud Run vs App Engine, **Unable to determine**). `/logos/ocg-mark.webp` returns `server: UploadServer` (Google Cloud Storage signature). Third-party CDNs: Cloudflare (CookieYes).
- HTML: `cache-control: s-maxage=31536000`, `x-nextjs-cache: HIT`, `x-nextjs-prerender: 1`, `x-nextjs-stale-time: 300` (prerendered/ISR), gzip, HTTP/3 advertised (`alt-svc: h3`).
- Security headers: `strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`, `x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN`, `x-content-type-options: nosniff`, `referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`. No Content-Security-Policy header observed.
- `content-signal: ai-train=yes, ai-search=yes` (Cloudflare-style content-signals header permitting AI training and search).
- Images via the Next.js optimiser (`/_next/image?url=…&w=…&q=75`, AVIF served to Chrome, 1x/2x `srcSet`); header logo `priority`; OCG mark preloaded and unoptimised.
- Fonts: next/font self-hosting (Roboto variable, Solitreo) with `<link rel="preload" as="font" crossorigin>`.
- Next `<Link>` prefetches RSC payloads for /contact, /about, /blogs, /creator/earn, /legal/* on load.
- Desktop load: 85 requests (18 first-party JS chunks, 2 CSS files of 21,049 + 486 bytes transferred, 2 fonts, 13 first-party images, 33 RSC prefetch fetches).

### Analytics, tags, consent
- **Google Tag Manager** `GTM-K66374CX`.
- **Google Analytics 4** `G-87CRRH8FXM` (inline `gtag('config', …, {send_page_view: false, cookie_flags: 'SameSite=None;Secure'})` + a manual `page_view` event) and a second GA4 stream `G-3G6S0WHSKP` seen in collect hits (configured inside GTM).
- **Microsoft Clarity** project `dwiqlxestpk` (loaded via the npm integration, `?ref=npm`).
- **CookieYes** consent banner (`cdn-cookieyes.com/client_data/373b191ed956d51fb9a13f028b26a8d6/…`); Google Consent Mode v2: the inline script sets every consent type to `granted` by default, while CookieYes's Consent Mode debug log at capture time reported Default/Update `denied` — the effective default state is therefore **Unable to determine** without a consent audit.
- All first-party analytics are gated by `window.__SPARK_ANALYTICS__` (true only on www.sparkonomy.com / sparkonomy.com).
- `facebook-domain-verification` meta present (no Meta Pixel requests observed).

### SEO & metadata
- `<title>`: "Sparkonomy – Sparking Creator Livelihoods"; meta description, keywords, `author` "Team Sparkonomy", `robots`/`googlebot` index, follow; canonical https://www.sparkonomy.com/; `lang="en"`; `og:locale` en_IN; OG + Twitter card (`summary_large_image`) with `/og-home-v2.png` 1200×630.
- JSON-LD: Organization (+ sameAs to the 5 social profiles), WebSite, WebPage (with `abstract`). The Organization logo is declared as 512×512 but `/sparkonomy.png` is actually 663×501.
- Favicons 192×192, 512×512 and apple-touch-icon 180×180; `theme-color` #000000.
- Two `<meta name="viewport">` tags are emitted (one with `viewport-fit=cover`).

### Accessibility observations
- Good: sr-only H1 text with aria-hidden decorative letters, labelled icon links, `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` on the menu toggle, Escape closes the menu, full `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback.
- Risks: very low-contrast text (READ OUR STORY at white/30 on black ≈ 2.5:1 at rest; menu labels white/30–35), the auto-scrolling tour (moves content without a pause control other than interacting), heavy GPU use from the fluid simulation, and the cookie bar overlapping the navigation.
designSystem:
There is no public design-system documentation; the system below is reconstructed from the computed CSS and the bundled constants (`INK`, `CTA_LABEL`, `NAV`, `FOOTER` …).

### Tokens
- **Colour**: black canvas; white text with opacity steps (.9/.85/.8/.75/.6/.5/.45/.35/.3/.1); brand inks `#DE0075` magenta, `#8134AF` violet, `#DD2A7B` pink, `#9747FF` purple, `#6C63FF` indigo (plus `#FF4F95` pinkLight, `#22D3EE` cyan, `#FFB020` gold defined for the fluid "tuned" mode); semantic stance colours green/amber/red; CSS custom property `--pink-to-purple: linear-gradient(162deg, #dd2a7b 4.78%, #9747ff 89.95%)`; shadcn HSL tokens `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--foreground-rgb: 255,255,255`, `--background-start-rgb`/`--background-end-rgb: 0,0,0`.
- **Gradients**: CTA `110deg #DE0075 0–8% → #8134AF 45–100%`; card border `133.52deg #DE0075 5.08% → #8134AF 28.61%`; record border `160deg` purple/magenta; glows as radial gradients.
- **Typography**: Roboto only; 4 weights (400/500/600/700); display 96, headline 64, sub-headline 44, card title 32, body-L 28.8, 24, 20, UI 15/14/13/12/11/10 (see Typography).
- **Spacing**: Tailwind 4px scale; recurring values 16/24/28/32/40/48/56/96px. Containers: 84rem (1344px) header & footer, 64rem (1024px) story text, 54rem (864px) Creator Record, 35rem (560px) hero card, 21.25rem (340px) record card.
- **Radius**: 9999px pills; 28px hero card; 24px/23px record card; 10px cookie bar (third-party); 6px cookie buttons.
- **Elevation**: no box-shadows; depth comes from glows (radial gradients, `blur-2xl`) and gradient hairline borders built with CSS masks.
- **Motion**: 150ms hover; 500ms word ink; 900–1,000ms reveals; 3.5s CTA sweep; 24s marquee; easing smoothstep (scroll), cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) (Tailwind default), cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) (card), easeInOutCubic (tour).

### Components
1. Fixed transparent header with scrim + gradient pill CTA; full-screen mobile menu.
2. Pill CTA (two sizes) with animated gradient.
3. "Launch card": translucent violet panel, gradient hairline border, NEW badge, product mark, title, CTA, caption.
4. Logo marquee (masked edges, duplicated list).
5. Pinned story screen (sticky 100svh stage, centred text, beat reveals, ink words, highlight colours).
6. Creator Record card (avatar + verified tick, claims row, stance pills, timestamp, stamp).
7. Footer (4-column grid, badges, social icons).
8. Third-party CookieYes top bar.

### Consistency notes
- One CTA destination everywhere (Open Creator Graph app); two CTA labels ("Claim your Creator Record" in navigation, "Claim your free Creator Record" in content).
- Header vs footer labels differ ("About" vs "About Us", "Contact" vs "Contact Us").
- "Terms of Services" (footer) is grammatically non-standard.
logoNotes:
- **Sparkonomy wordmark** — two-weight logotype "**Spark**onomy" (bold "Spark", light "onomy"). Header version white (`/logos/logo_header_white.png`, 991×188 PNG, rendered 26px tall); footer version grey with a purple paw-print/spark mark replacing the "o" (`/logos/logo_header_gray.png`, 523×96, rendered 24px tall). Both are raster PNGs (no SVG logo on the page).
- **Hero wordmark** is live text, not an image (H1 with per-letter gradient colours).
- **Favicon / app icons** — grey "S" on a black-to-purple circle: 192×192, 512×512, apple-touch 180×180.
- **JSON-LD logo** `/sparkonomy.png` — glowing indigo "S" on black (663×501; declared 512×512); not rendered on the page.
- **Open Creator Graph mark** — circular network/constellation "S" in magenta/purple on white lines (`/logos/ocg-mark.webp`, 160×160).
- **Partner logos** (white, transparent PNG, all labelled as program/affiliation badges): "Built with Meta", "Developed with YouTube", "Google for Startups", "Gemini Early Access Program".
- **Compliance badges** (white circular seals): DPDP (India Digital Personal Data Protection Act), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), PDPA (Singapore Personal Data Protection Act), GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). The PDPA original is 2048×2048 while the others are 160×160.
- **Third-party**: CookieYes wordmark (inline SVG in the cookie banner).
- Originals were downloaded from the un-optimised source paths (the page itself serves them through `/_next/image` as AVIF).
assetsNotes:
Assets were downloaded from their **original source URLs** (for `/_next/image?url=…` optimiser URLs the decoded `url` path was fetched, e.g. `/logos/Meta_White.png`, so files are the untouched originals rather than resized AVIFs). Inline SVGs were serialised from the DOM. Naming and categories are set in `data/raw/asset-overrides.json`.

- **logos/** — brand wordmarks, favicons, OCG mark, partner logos, compliance badges, CookieYes wordmark (third-party).
- **images/** — Creator avatar (demo persona) and the Open Graph share image.
- **icons/** — hamburger PNG, chevron, verified tick, 5 social icons, CookieYes close icon (third-party).
- **illustrations/** — "CERTIFIED" stamp graphic.
- **videos/** — none: the homepage has no `<video>`, Lottie or GIF. All motion is CSS/JS/WebGL.
- **backgrounds/** — none as files: the background is a real-time WebGL simulation (no image) plus CSS gradients (vignette, header scrim, card glows), documented in the Colour and Animation chapters.

Excluded: Google Tag Manager tracking pixel (`/td?id=GTM-…`) and analytics beacons.
socialNotes:
- All five profiles appear **only in the footer** as 24×24 inline-SVG icon links (no text), `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`, colour rgba(255,255,255,.5) → white on hover.
- The same five URLs are listed in the JSON-LD `Organization.sameAs`.
- Handles: X **@SparkonomySays**; Instagram **sparkonomy.official**; YouTube **@Sparkonomy.official**; LinkedIn company **sparkonomy**; Reddit user **u/Sparkonomy**.
- No Facebook, TikTok, Threads, Discord or WhatsApp links; no share buttons; no embedded feeds.
